07.05.2025 CLR No.121 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
The proposed Revision has been 
filed against the judgment and decree 
dated 01.10.2024, passed by learned 
Judge, Small Cause Court/District Judge, 
Haridwar in SCC Suit No.07 of 2023, 
whereby, the learned Judge has decreed 
the suit for recovery of possession, rent, 
mesne profit with other consequential 
reliefs. 
2. Heard Mr. Narenda Bali, learned 
counsel for proposed revisionist and Mr. 
Birendra Singh Adhikari, learned counsel 
for respondent. 
3. Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate, 
submitted on instruction that the 
revisionist is ready to hand over the 
vacant possession of the property-in￾question within eleven months from 
today along with mesne profits at the 
rate of Rs.11,000/- per month or allow to 
revisionist to hand over the property-in￾question within one and a half year with 
mesne profits at the rate of Rs.13,000/-
per month.  4. Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate, has 
sought one week’s time to file an 
affidavit of the revisionist in this regard. 
5. Admit.
6. List on 23.05.2025. Till then, 
further proceedings of Execution Case 
No.01 of 2024 are stayed on the 
conditions that the revisionist shall 
deposit/pay the entire decreetal amount 
by the date fixed. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)

Mr. Narendra Bali, learned counsel for

the respondent.
3. Money withdrawal application 
(IA/6/2025) has been filed by the 
respondent /landlord. In compliance of the 
order passed by this Court dated 
07.05.2025, the decreetal amount has been 
deposited by the revisionist before the 
concerned Court.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent 
has filed money withdrawal application 
along with annexure-1 in which details of 
the decreetal amount deposited by the 
revisionist from 01.08.2023 to 30.04.2025 
has been specified which reveals that an 
amount of ₹3,59,666/- has been deposited 
by the revisionist.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent 
has prayed for withdrawal of the said 
amount.
6. Learned counsel for the revisionist 
has no objection to the said money 
withdrawal application.
7. In view of the above, money 
withdrawal application is allowed.
8. In case an application is filed by the 
respondent for withdrawal of an amount of 
₹3,59,666/- before the concerned Court,  the same shall be considered and the said 
amount shall be permitted to be withdrawn 
in favour of the respondent.
9. List this case on 19.06.2026.
10. Interim order granted earlier is 
extended till the next date of listing.
 (Subhash Upadhyay,J.)
